evals.name: directory-entry
evals.prompt: Import new authors from the Library's directory. Model the first entry for Aster.
evals.expected_output: A keyed inbound capture that maps the name to the local event.
assertions: Identifies the source and route of the directory API.
Uses its stable ID as the capture key.
Maps the supplied name into DirectoryAuthorSeen on addition.

evals.name: repeated-entry
evals.prompt: Two polls return the same author unchanged. Verify the second outcome without calling the API.
evals.expected_output: A model spec in which a repeat with the same key produces no event.
assertions: Supplies the previous capture as given state.
Repeats the same ID and name.
Expects no events rather than a validation refusal.
Uses a model test without an actual poll.

evals.name: public-event-boundary
evals.prompt: The directory can publish AuthorAnnounced instead of serving a poll. Show how the Library records the incoming name without treating the directory's event as a Library fact.
evals.expected_output: An inbound event capture with an addressed local fact and a specification.
assertions: Declares the public event with its origin and names it as the event source for capture.
Keys the capture from stable author identity in the payload.
Maps the name to a separate local event.
Uses an append stimulus and checks the local event's address and name.
